title: Low-cost open-access tool for rooftop PV assessment in informal settlements
content:
Researchers in Brazil developed a low-cost method combining UAV photogrammetry, GIS analysis, and an open-source Python tool to estimate rooftop solar PV potential in informal settlements with good accuracy. Applied in two Brazilian communities, the approach identified 338 kW of installable PV capacity—capable of generating about 437,000 kWh annually and meeting roughly 61% of local household electricity demand.

title: U.S. solar module assembly prices stabilize as trade cases and ownership shifts shake supply chains

title: Solar’s emerging steel bottleneck: Capacity, compliance, and closed-loop supply
